seo.title: Free AdSense Revenue Calculator – RPM & CPC Modes
seo.description: Estimate AdSense earnings from pageviews with Zetawala’s free calculator. Use RPM mode (pageviews ÷ 1,000 × RPM) or CPC mode (pageviews × CTR × CPC) for daily, monthly, and yearly projections—deterministic math only, no AI.

faqs.a: Monthly revenue = (Monthly pageviews ÷ 1,000) × RPM. Daily ≈ monthly ÷ 30; yearly = monthly × 12.
Clicks = Pageviews × CTR%. Revenue = Clicks × CPC. The same daily/monthly/yearly scaling applies.

faqs.q: Is this official Google AdSense data?
faqs.a: No. It is a free estimator using the RPM, CTR, or CPC you enter. Real AdSense varies by niche, geo, seasonality, and ad layout.

faqs.q: Does the AdSense calculator use AI?
faqs.a: No. Earnings are computed with transparent formulas so publishers can plan without model-generated guesses.

faqs.q: Who should use an AdSense revenue calculator?
faqs.a: Bloggers, news publishers, and niche site owners forecasting display revenue before growing traffic or redesigning ad placements.

faqs.q: Which mode should I choose—RPM or CPC?
faqs.a: Use RPM if you know earnings per thousand pageviews from AdSense reports. Use CPC if you track click-through rate and average click value instead.

ui.disclaimer: Instant local calculation — no AI calls. Results update as you type. Estimates only; verify with your own data.
